findings.finding: The model-assisted path depends on requests>=2.28 plus a user-supplied OpenAI-compatible endpoint, model identifier, and API credential (README example uses DASHSCOPE_API_KEY). The model/base_url are placeholders rather than immutable service snapshots, and requests has only a lower bound. Exact model-assisted replay therefore depends on non-pinned remote/service and environment state.
findings.boundary: This is an exact-replay provenance limitation, not evidence that model-assisted outputs are incorrect.
